scope: Preserved best usable complete configuration against the final configuration on complete serving. Separate loads, monitoring off, no telemetry, the reference prompts and setup sequence.

old.binary: Rebuilt from its source tree. Hash 63e53f2e differs from the reference 94cd6ffc, whose file was not retained, so this arm is identified by source commit. The shared donor tree and embedded paths can differ.

new.source_commit: c945940 for the engine, this branch for the server

conditioning.prompt: How many minutes are in one hour? Give the number.
Write a Python function count_initials(names) that ignores empty or whitespace-only strings and counts the first letter of each stripped name case-insensitively. Show one example.

Write a clear short explanation for new volunteers about labeling seed envelopes: include plant name, harvest month, and storage instructions. Keep a friendly tone and avoid unsupported shelf-life claims.
Summarize this maintenance log as three bullet points without adding facts: Pump B was inspected Monday. Its seal was replaced Tuesday. A test on Wednesday found no leakage. Pump A was not inspected.

Mira has three labeled boxes. Exactly one contains a coin. The red box label says the coin is here. The blue label says the coin is not in the red box. The green label says the coin is in the blue box. Exactly one label is true. Which box contains the coin? Explain briefly.
Use location_lookup to find the stored location for shipment parcel-82. Do not guess the location.

function.name: location_lookup
function.description: Look up the stored location of a shipment

conditioning.purpose: Exercise ordinary one-row generation through the actual public serving path; the other four requests exercise DSpark grouped verification. This is a required caller check, not a width comparison.

telemetry.fields: pstate, graphics and memory clock, power, utilization, temperature. Read-only NVML. Clock-event reasons and PCIe throughput excluded from arms because they cost 35 and 21 ms per read on the 3090.

study.rule: tools/mm3/native_final_comparison.py. A load is the replicate. Confirmed at a budget: mean pooled gain at least 2%, 95% interval across the three pairs excluding zero, neither prompt negative. Otherwise reported as measured, not confirmed. Every cell where the new engine is slower is listed as a regression. Load order is old, new, new, old, old, new.

stopping.rule: All six loads, evaluated once. A failed setup step stops the campaign for inspection; it does not replace a load. Usability checks run after the last load in the same process, on the final configuration.
